scores.label: A
scores.note: option 5 'startled of' is ungrammatical and means surprised, not afraid; option 6 'panic-stricken of' ungrammatical and odd; option 7 'dreadful' and option 9 'eerie' describe what causes fear, the wrong sense; option 10 'afraid of' doubles 'of' in place

scores.label: B
scores.note: option 4 'dismayed' means disappointed; options 5 'shocked', 6 'startled' and 9 'astounded' mean surprised, and none takes 'of'; option 7 'appalled' is disgust with the wrong preposition; option 8 'aghast of' ungrammatical and rare

scores.label: C
scores.note: option 4 'is dreaded of' and option 5 'is feared of' are ungrammatical and reverse who fears whom; option 7 'startled of' means surprised and is ungrammatical; option 9 'appalled' is disgust with the wrong preposition; option 10 'ghastly' describes the cause of horror, wrong sense
